groundTruth.summary: Mocks cast as `as unknown as MockedObject<T>` — the unknown hop is redundant.

groundTruth.author: LucieFaire
groundTruth.summary: `as never` casts on mock resolved values and the spaceId argument — avoid.

findings.finding: Four mocks typed `as unknown as MockedObject<T>` instead of a direct `as MockedObject<T>` cast.
`as never` casts lie to the type system on mockResolvedValue arguments and on `spaceId as never` (root cause: spaceId is an untyped faker string instead of the nominal UUID type per TYPE-01).
filterUndeployed fails open (catch → treat as undeployed and keep the row); STYLE-01's safe-default clause arguably wants fail-closed, though a test documents the fail-open intent.
